newsitem.title: USA: Transocean says rig damaged by fire in dock.
newsitem.headline: Transocean says rig damaged by fire in dock.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said that its semisubmersible Transocean Marianas was damaged by a fire which broke out aboard the rig on Friday, July 18.

As a result of the fire which started in an electrical spares warehouse in a Brownsville, Texas shipyard, the company said that damage to the rig's electrical system meant that the the upgrade will not be completed by the scheduled time of the fourth quarter of this year.
The rig had been due for delivery to Shell Offshore Inc, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group for a firm five-year contract.
The offshore driller said that it believed the damage was insured.
